---
name: code-reviewer
description: "Reviews code changes for correctness, clarity, and maintainability. Use when requesting a code review for Java/Kotlin files in ClickDungeon."
applyTo: "app/**"
---

This agent performs a focused code review: identifies bugs, API misuse, style inconsistencies, and suggests concise fixes or refactors. It can produce a review summary, a set of suggested patches, or a checklist for follow-up tasks.
